title: KestrelCare Claim Odometer Readings and the Trade-In Mileage Charge
content:
Kestrel holds its own odometer record of a traded vehicle when the vehicle carries a contract under **KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts**: the latest adjudicated repair claim, by failure date, on the KestrelCare service contract written on the traded vehicle's VIN. That claim's failure date and its odometer at failure are the date and the reading of the record. Under **Trade-In Agreements** this record decides which miles of the mileage overage found at pickup are charged.

## Rule

- **Claim in the window, reading at or below the stated mileage.** When the record's failure date falls on or before the offer date and no more than 60 days before it, and the reading is at or below the stated mileage, only the miles of the overage beyond the mileage tolerance allowed are charged, never fewer than none.
- **Claim in the window, reading above the stated mileage.** When the failure date falls in the same window and the reading is above the stated mileage, every mile of the overage is charged whatever its size, with no tolerance test.
- **Every other case.** With no such claim, or a claim outside the window, the record does not change which miles are charged: every mile of the overage is charged when the overage is greater than the mileage tolerance allowed, and nothing is charged otherwise.

The overage is the inspected mileage less the stated mileage, both from the trade-in agreement; the offer date is the one shown on the agreement.

## The window

| Failure date of the latest adjudicated claim | In the window? |
|---|---|
| On the offer date | Yes |
| 60 days before the offer date | Yes |
| 61 days before the offer date | No |
| After the offer date | No |

## Decision table (hypothetical figures)

Stated mileage 50000; mileage tolerance allowed 1000 miles; inspected mileage 51800, an overage of 1800 miles.

| Latest adjudicated claim on the VIN's KestrelCare contract | Miles charged |
|---|---|
| Failed 20 days before the offer date at 49600 miles | 800 (the overage beyond 1000) |
| Failed 20 days before the offer date at 50300 miles | 1800 (every mile, no tolerance test) |
| Failed 90 days before the offer date at 49600 miles | 1800 (overage greater than 1000) |
| No claim on record | 1800 (overage greater than 1000) |

With the same claim at 50300 miles and an overage of only 400 miles, all 400 miles are charged; with the claim at 49600 miles and the same 400-mile overage, none are.
